title: Help Vasilisa the Wise 2
statementMd:
Vasilisa the Wise from the Kingdom of Far Far Away got a magic box with a secret as a present from her friend Hellawisa the Wise from the Kingdom of A Little Closer. However, Vasilisa the Wise does not know what the box's secret is, since she cannot open it again. She hopes that you will help her one more time with that.

The box's lock looks as follows: it contains $4$ identical deepenings for gems as a $2 × 2$ square, and some integer numbers are written at the lock's edge near the deepenings. The example of a lock is given on the picture below.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/127c7d97f5f9a5325756ac217e39f1c13877c4c5.png)

The box is accompanied with $9$ gems. Their shapes match the deepenings' shapes and each gem contains one number from $1$ to $9$ (each number is written on exactly one gem). The box will only open after it is decorated with gems correctly: that is, each deepening in the lock should be filled with exactly one gem. Also, the sums of numbers in the square's rows, columns and two diagonals of the square should match the numbers written at the lock's edge. For example, the above lock will open if we fill the deepenings with gems with numbers as is shown on the picture below.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/393eab7d3f4fec2231447807c31dcde2fce6a958.png)

Now Vasilisa the Wise wants to define, given the numbers on the box's lock, which gems she should put in the deepenings to open the box. Help Vasilisa to solve this challenging task.

## Input

The input contains numbers written on the edges of the lock of the box. The first line contains space-separated integers $*r*_{1}$ and $*r*_{2}$ that define the required sums of numbers in the rows of the square. The second line contains space-separated integers $*c*_{1}$ and $*c*_{2}$ that define the required sums of numbers in the columns of the square. The third line contains space-separated integers $*d*_{1}$ and $*d*_{2}$ that define the required sums of numbers on the main and on the side diagonals of the square ($1 ≤ *r*_{1}, *r*_{2}, *c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, *d*_{1}, *d*_{2} ≤ 20$). Correspondence between the above 6 variables and places where they are written is shown on the picture below. For more clarifications please look at the second sample test that demonstrates the example given in the problem statement.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4073cdd8ce49caace5c671d9455b35a21156a336.png)

## Output

Print the scheme of decorating the box with stones: two lines containing two space-separated integers from $1$ to $9$. The numbers should be pairwise different. If there is no solution for the given lock, then print the single number "`-1`" (without the quotes).

If there are several solutions, output any.

## Note

Pay attention to the last test from the statement: it is impossible to open the box because for that Vasilisa the Wise would need 4 identical gems containing number "5". However, Vasilisa only has one gem with each number from $1$ to $9$.
statementZhMd:
来自遥远王国的聪明的瓦西丽萨收到了一份来自稍近王国的聪明的赫拉维萨送给她的礼物——一个带有秘密的魔盒。然而，聪明的瓦西丽萨不知道盒子的秘密是什么，因为她无法再次打开它。她希望你能再一次帮助她。

魔盒的锁如下所示：它包含 $4$ 个形状相同、用于放置宝石的凹槽，这些凹槽排列成一个 $2 × 2$ 的正方形，凹槽旁边的锁边上写着一些整数。下图展示了一个锁的例子。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/127c7d97f5f9a5325756ac217e39f1c13877c4c5.png)

魔盒附带 $9$ 颗宝石。它们的形状与凹槽的形状相匹配，并且每颗宝石上都写有一个从 $1$ 到 $9$ 的数字（每个数字恰好写在一颗宝石上）。只有正确地装饰魔盒后，盒子才会打开：也就是说，锁上的每个凹槽都必须恰好放入一颗宝石。此外，正方形的每一行、每一列以及两条对角线上的数字之和，都必须分别等于锁边上写出的数字。例如，按照下图所示的方式放入宝石，上面的锁就会打开。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/393eab7d3f4fec2231447807c31dcde2fce6a958.png)

现在，聪明的瓦西丽萨想根据魔盒锁上的数字，确定应该将哪些宝石放入凹槽中以打开魔盒。请帮助瓦西丽萨解决这个具有挑战性的任务。

## 输入格式

输入包含写在魔盒锁边上的数字。第一行包含用空格分隔的整数 $*r*_{1}$ 和 $*r*_{2}$，表示正方形两行中数字之和的要求值。第二行包含用空格分隔的整数 $*c*_{1}$ 和 $*c*_{2}$，表示正方形两列中数字之和的要求值。第三行包含用空格分隔的整数 $*d*_{1}$ 和 $*d*_{2}$，表示正方形主对角线和副对角线上数字之和的要求值（$1 ≤ *r*_{1}, *r*_{2}, *c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, *d*_{1}, *d*_{2} ≤ 20$）。上述 $6$ 个变量与其在锁边上的位置之间的对应关系如下图所示。若需进一步说明，请参阅第二个样例测试，其中展示了题面中给出的例子。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4073cdd8ce49caace5c671d9455b35a21156a336.png)

## 输出格式

输出用宝石装饰魔盒的方案：输出两行，每行包含两个用空格分隔的、取值范围为 $1$ 到 $9$ 的整数。这些数字必须两两不同。如果给定的锁不存在解，则输出单独的数字 `-1`（不含引号）。

如果有多个解，输出任意一个即可。

## 说明

请注意题面中的最后一个测试：无法打开魔盒，因为聪明的瓦西丽萨需要 $4$ 颗都写有数字“5”的相同宝石。然而，她只有一颗写有 $1$ 到 $9$ 中每个数字的宝石。
